lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p13 - 1. Talk about the pictures. Make predictions.

details: Talk about the pictures reviews the target language and structures from the unit and engages students in the story before they’ve listened to it by asking them to predict what happens.
Look for accurate identification and correct pronunciation of the target language, and predictions relevant to the topic.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

details: Act out the story uses TPR to strengthen word-sound recognition, and listening for key details skills by asking students to raise their flashcards when they hear specific words.
Look for correct raising of the flashcards when the target word is heard, appropriate actions for each frame in the story, and confident participation.

lessonPlan.topic: Numbers Book p95 - 1. Draw and make 10.

details: Draw and make 10 reinforces the numbers 1-10, provides controlled practice of number bonds to ten, and develops fine motor skills.
Look for correct pencil grip, accurate counting, the correct number of items drawn to make ten, and neat number formation within the lines.

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down:

Make 10. Colour reinforces the numbers 1-10, provides controlled practice of number bonds to ten, and develops fine motor skills.

Look for correct pencil grip, accurate counting, red circles increasing by one each time and blue circles decreasing by one each time, careful colouring of the circles that is mostly in within the lines.
